description: Apex Intelligence is an AI-focused team building an interactive mapping & surface navigation tool for the Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map challenge using satellite datasets & AI models.
summary: MARSWALK: Interplanetary Survival Guide · Jezero EVA Planner is a mission-control web HUD designed for planning safe, science-driven human Extravehicular Activities (EVAs) at Jezero Crater, Mars. The platform fuses over six real NASA data layers—including JPL Mars Trek WMTS basemaps (Viking optical, MOLA/HRSC hillshade, THEMIS Day-IR thermal), CTX 20m DEM and HiRISE topography, CRISM mineral prospectivity, REMS surface weather, and DONKI space-weather radiation advisories. Powered by machine learning models calibrated on 4,178 Perseverance SPICE waypoints (achieving 99.1% alignment with EVA safety rules), MARSWALK evaluates terrain traversability, science value, and seasonal dust conditions. An A* pathfinding engine computes optimal walking routes avoiding slopes above 20° while tracking astronaut oxygen, water, and power consumables alongside a live GO/HOLD advisory, Mars solar clock, and Perseverance ground-level POV target previews.
details:
MARSWALK: Interplanetary Survival Guide · Jezero EVA Planner is a mission-control web HUD designed for planning safe, science-driven human Extravehicular Activities (EVAs) at Jezero Crater, Mars. Unlike global mapping portals, it fuses hyper-localized planetary datasets into a single actionable astronaut decision screen.

How It Works & Key Features: The platform integrates over six NASA data layers—including JPL Mars Trek WMTS basemaps (Viking optical, MOLA/HRSC hillshade, THEMIS Day-IR thermal), CTX 20m DEM and HiRISE topography, CRISM mineral prospectivity, REMS surface weather, and DONKI space-weather radiation advisories. Machine learning models calibrated on 4,178 Perseverance SPICE waypoints (achieving 99.1% alignment with EVA safety rules) evaluate terrain traversability, scientific value, and seasonal dust risks. An A* pathfinding engine generates optimal routes avoiding slopes above 20° while tracking astronaut oxygen, water, and power consumables alongside live GO/HOLD advisories, a Mars solar clock validated against 4,745 REMS sols, and Perseverance ground-level POV target previews.

Tech Stack & Impact: Built using Next.js, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, and Vercel, MARSWALK addresses astronaut suit mobility constraints, radiation hazards, and scientific prioritization—bridging orbital telemetry with surface-level operational safety for future human Mars missions.
